<fetch version="1.0" output-format="xml-platform" mapping="logical" distinct="false">
  <entity name="new_invoice">
    <attribute name="new_invoiceid" />
    <attribute name="new_name" />
    <attribute name="createdon" />
    <attribute name="new_total_base" />
    <attribute name="new_total" />
    <attribute name="statuscode" />
    <attribute name="new_purchaseorderid" />
    <attribute name="new_invoiceref" />
    <attribute name="new_invoicedate" />
    <attribute name="transactioncurrencyid" />
    <attribute name="new_clientid" />
    <attribute name="new_contactid" />
    <attribute name="new_batchid" />
    <attribute name="new_assignmentid" />
    <order attribute="new_name" descending="false" />
    <filter type="and">
      <condition attribute="new_batchid" operator="eq"  uitype="new_batch" value="@{outputs('Get_a_Batch_row_by_ID')?['body/new_batchid']}" />
    </filter>
  </entity>
</fetch>
